info.title: Live TTS WebSocket API
info.description:
Bidirectional WebSocket API for real-time text-to-speech. Stream text in,
receive synthesized audio (plus optional word-level timestamps) out as
binary frames in strict segment order.

production.description: Production WebSocket server. Authenticate via the `x-api-key` header, or the `?api_key=...` query parameter for clients that cannot set headers.

clientSend.summary: Client sends session config + streaming text

serverSend.summary: Server sends ordered segment audio + lifecycle events

SessionStart.name: SessionStart
SessionStart.title: Start Session (first frame)
SessionStart.summary: Must be the very first message sent on the WebSocket. Configures the synthesis run.

voice_id.description: CambAI voice ID. Validated using the same rules as `/tts-stream`.

language.description: BCP-47 locale (e.g. `en-us`, `hi-in`, `zh-cn`). Must be supported by `mars-8.1-flash-beta`.

word_timestamps.description: When true, the server includes per-word timing data (`word_timestamps`) on each `segment.start`.

idle_timeout.description: Fallback flush, in seconds, for trailing text fragments that don't end in a sentence boundary. Complete sentences (terminal punctuation, paragraph break, etc.) are flushed immediately and never wait on this timer. Bump up (e.g. `2.5`) when the producer stalls *mid*-sentence — slower LLMs, token-level jitter — to avoid splitting a sentence across two segments. Lower it for tighter tail-latency on live captioning / mic input.

enhance_named_entities_pronunciation.description: If true, improves pronunciation of names, brands, and other named entities. Mirrors `/tts-stream`.

apply_enhancement.description:
If true, applies output audio enhancement (loudness, denoising, polish). Defaults to the
speech-model's per-engine default when omitted (off for the speed-oriented `mars-flash`
and `mars-8.1-flash-beta` models, on otherwise). Mirrors `/tts-stream`
`output_configuration.apply_enhancement`.

enhance_reference_audio_quality.description: If true, removes noise/compression from the reference audio before cloning. Mirrors `/tts-stream` `voice_settings.enhance_reference_audio_quality`.

maintain_source_accent.description: If true, preserves the accent of the reference voice. Mirrors `/tts-stream` `voice_settings.maintain_source_accent`.

speaking_rate.description: Speech pace multiplier (e.g. `1.5`). Mirrors `/tts-stream` `voice_settings.speaking_rate`. Pass-through to the TTS engine.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. Mirrors `/tts-stream` `output_configuration.sample_rate`.

TextChunk.name: TextChunk
TextChunk.title: Append Text
TextChunk.summary: Push more text into the synthesis buffer. The server segments based on content, not chunk boundaries.

TextDone.name: TextDone
TextDone.title: End of Input
TextDone.summary: Flush whatever is buffered and finish. Optional — the server also flushes after `LIVE_TTS_IDLE_FLUSH_SECONDS` (default 1s) of silence.

run_id.description: ID of the `TTS_API` Run created for this session.

config.description: Echo of the resolved session configuration (without `reference_audio`).

SegmentStart.name: SegmentStart
SegmentStart.title: Segment Start
SegmentStart.summary: Marks the beginning of a synthesized segment. Followed by one or more binary audio frames and then `segment.done`.

text.description: The exact text that produced this segment's audio.

word_timestamps.description: Per-word timing data. Present only when `word_timestamps=true` was set on `session.start` and resolution succeeded.

start.description: Start time in seconds, relative to the segment.

end.description: End time in seconds, relative to the segment.

AudioChunk.name: AudioChunk
AudioChunk.title: Binary Audio Frame
AudioChunk.summary: Raw audio bytes for the current segment. Up to `LIVE_TTS_AUDIO_FRAME_MAX_BYTES` (default 65536) per frame.

SegmentDone.name: SegmentDone
SegmentDone.title: Segment Done
SegmentDone.summary: All audio for the current segment has been emitted.

SegmentSkipped.name: SegmentSkipped
SegmentSkipped.title: Segment Skipped
SegmentSkipped.summary: TTS retries were exhausted for this segment. The session continues; resend the text via `text.chunk` if needed.

SessionDone.name: SessionDone
SessionDone.title: Session Done
SessionDone.summary: Pipeline drained, all segments emitted. Followed by a normal close.

SessionError.name: SessionError
SessionError.title: Session Error
SessionError.summary: Fatal session-level error. Followed by a close with code 4400 / 4401 / 4402.
